paragraphs.text: Local desktop wallpaper behind a translucent DeepSeek Harness window
# dsh-wallpaper-glass
Puts the **local desktop wallpaper** behind the DeepSeek Harness main window: the window turns trans
lucent, the wallpaper is pixel-aligned with the desktop (the window behaves like a hole cut into it)
, it follows wallpaper changes live, and it adapts the readability veil to how bright the image is.
**Dialogs, menu panels and the embedded browser keep their original opaque backgrounds.**
## What it does
| Ability | How |
| Show the real local wallpaper | The Host resolves the file the OS is displaying (Windows: `Transco

dedWallpaper` → registry → `CachedFiles`) and serves it over a session-guarded local route |
| Make
the main window translucent | The browser half rewrites the surface tokens (`--dsw-alias-bg-*`, `--d
sw-specific-sidebar-fill`, `…-input-major`, `…-bubble`) through `ctx.theme.overrideTokens`; only the

main shell turns to glass |
| Pixel alignment (default on) | A screen-sized plate sits inside the f
ixed layer at a negative offset equal to the window's screen position, so the window shows the very
same region of the desktop; moves, resizes, edge-snaps and maximized windows are followed within 250

ms (negative origins, including Windows' -8 maximized frame, stay aligned) |
| Follow the desktop f
ill mode | Reads `WallpaperStyle` / `TileWallpaper` and supports fill / fit / stretch / center / til

e |
| Follow the local wallpaper | The page asks `/dsh-wallpaper/meta` every 4 s; the Host only `sta

t`s the file. A new `mtime-size` revision swaps the image, slideshow included |
| Adapt to brightnes
s | The image is averaged on a 32 px canvas; a light theme hazes a dark wallpaper and a dark theme d

eepens a bright one |
| Keep overlays solid | Dialogs (`role=dialog`), menus/lists/tooltips (`role=m
enu/listbox/tooltip`) and the panels around embedded `iframe`/`webview` elements are reset to the or

iginal opaque palette |
| Keep inputs solid | The composer's surface token is no longer overridden,
and every search/text field finds whichever ancestor actually paints its background and marks it `da

ta-dshp-solid`, restoring the original palette |
| Deepen light labels | In the light theme `label-s
econdary` / `label-tertiary` / `label-caption` / `menu-icon` each drop one palette step (secondary `
#61666b → #353638`), placeholders included; the dark theme keeps its original values |
## The corner control
A draggable `◐` pill sits in the bottom-right corner (its position is remembered):

- **壁纸** — show / hide
- **透明度** — subtle / medium / strong
- **虚化** — 0 / 8 / 16 / 28 px
- **对齐桌面**

— on / off
- **重置本机设置**
Choices live in `localStorage`, so they survive reloads and restarts. Set `controls: false` to remov
e the pill entirely.

## Install / uninstall
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Installing writes the dependency into the profile manifest and appends the bundle to `dsh.profile.bu
ndles`. With HMR enabled a saved config recomposes live; otherwise restart the client.
## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- Structure: `#dshp-wallpaper` (fixed, `z-index:-1`, `overflow:hidden`) contains `#dshp-plate` (scre
en-sized, negative offset, `background-size: cover`), so the window reveals exactly the desktop regi

on behind it.
- When the window is on a secondary display, at a negative origin, or the metrics are
unavailable, it falls back to covering the window itself (`data-align="fallback"`) instead of showin

g a gap.
- `html/body/#root` are forced transparent; dialogs and embedded browsers reset the tokens
to their original opaque values, and the two panel levels around an `iframe`/`webview` get a `data-d

shp-solid` marker.
- All three routes go through `connection.requestRejection()`, so the wallpaper i

s never served to an unauthenticated request.
- File reads retry three times, because Windows can ho
ld `TranscodedWallpaper` while it rewrites it.
## Compatibility and known limits
- **Windows** — prefers `%APPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Themes\TranscodedWallpaper`, then the `WallPape

r` registry value, then the newest file in `Themes\CachedFiles`.
- **macOS** — `osascript` desktop p

icture; **Linux** — `gsettings picture-uri`. Both are best-effort and assume the fill mode.
- **Mult
iple monitors** — Windows' `TranscodedWallpaper` is the primary display's composite; a window dragge

d to another display falls back to covering itself.
- **Position precision** — depends on `window.sc
reenX/screenY` and `screen.width/height` in CSS px; frameless windows (this app) align exactly, fram

ed windows can be a few pixels off.
- **Plain browser access** — the wallpaper still renders inside

the page, but the browser window is opaque, so there is no "hole in the desktop" effect.
- **Older D
SH** — without `overrideTokens` the wallpaper layer still renders and no transparency is applied.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`dev/preview.mjs` accepts `?screen=1920x1080,400,300&dpr=1` to simulate display geometry for the pix
el-alignment check; screenshots can be taken with headless `msedge --headless --screenshot`.
